thread:
Maria (release): Hey team — quick heads-up: final RC cutover is in ~2h, code freeze goes into effect at 18:00 PT. If you absolutely need a late merge, post a one-line reason + risk/rollback plan in this thread and tag me. Changelog PRs need to be in within the next hour. @here

Alex K: Adding PR I need merged: #6123 — version bump to 1.9.0, docs only (changelog entry at #6130). No runtime changes.

Priya S: FWIW I have a runtime/embeds change landed on feature/emb-runtime. That's not docs-only; we should avoid merging to release without SRE perf signoff.

Sam R: I can run a quick smoke/perf check on staging in ~20m. If nothing spikes we can consider exception for low-risk merges.

Jared L: Note the bento build in my PR touches packaging binaries — rebuilding on release branch is a pain. Strongly prefer postponing that to next patch.

Deploy Bot: staging deploy triggered: build-2023-1767 -> started. Status updates will post here.

Maria (release): Thanks. Alex — please rebase onto release/1.9.x and add changelog snippet (one paragraph). Priya — open a formal exception request if you think the runtime change is critical; include test matrix and rollback steps (link to exception template: https://go/release-exception-template).

Alex K: Done — PR #6199 rebased onto release/1.9.x and changelog snippet added under "bugfixes". Risk: docs/changelog only. Requesting merge exception.

Maria (release): Quick review: looks docs-only, approving exception pending CI. @Ops Team please ack for final go/no-go on merging during freeze.

Ops Team: Acknowledged — we approve docs-only exceptions. Watchlist: tokenization perf and any 5xx spikes for 30m post-merge.

Sam R: Staging smoke completed: no perf regressions, error rates normal.

Alex K: CI green on #6199, merging now (will monitor). Command I ran locally: `git rebase release/1.9.x && hub api repos/redwood/infra/pulls/6199/merge -F commit_title='merge docs bump'`.

Maria (release): Approved and noted in the cutoff log. Thanks everyone — keep an eye on Sentry/console for the next 30m. If anything pops up we’ll roll back. :thumbsup:

Alex K: :thumbsup: merging and will post status in ~5m.

Deploy Bot: production deploy queued: awaiting window (post-freeze manual merges will be gated).
